rows.en: You did well on that op.
Next op, I'm counting on you too.
Hey, you're pretty good!
Guess I can't talk big anymore.
Guess you didn't need my support.
It's not like I'm in the military by choice.
Oh boy, sortieing with you again today?
Seriously, who has time to babysit you?
Hey, don't rush out recklessly.
Yeah, yeah, I'm going without being told.
Ah, wait a second.
Don't panic. Calm down.
Yes, yes, support understood.
I feel like I'll be fine with you.
Leave the support to me.
I wish we could have flown side by side somewhere else.
Well, aren't you good.
You're awfully strong, aren't you.
Are you actually serious, pal?
rows.notes: 'Otaku' here is the colloquial 'you' (otaku), not the fan term.

rows.en: Well then, time to head back.
You okay, pal?
rows.notes: 'Otaku' here is the colloquial 'you', not the fan term.

rows.en: That went okay.
Aw, now I owe you one.
rows.notes: Heard 'kari wo tsukuccha' as 'hunting'; read as 'kari' (debt).

rows.en: Same again next time!
Op's over. How about we go all out tonight?
Shall we make a little detour on the way back?
Hey, isn't that pretty amazing?
Alright, time to get out of here!
rows.notes: Subject not stated; escape of the group or Hikaru alone.

rows.en: Can I really do support work?
My manager sure lined up quite a job for me.
I'm ready! Let's do our best together.
Huh? Really? It's starting?
Hmm, I wonder if I'll make it in time for the concert.
I'm a little nervous, but I'll do my very best too.
Do your very best!
Show me your cool side once in a while!
No way, that's amazing!
It's dangerous like this!
That looks painful. Are you okay?
Oh, how unlucky.
Did they get shot down?
Oh, stop it. You're always joking.
Oh no!
You came to help me!
Thank you. You came to back us up, right?
Huh? Is that someone on our side?
Mm-hm. Good work.
We did it! Isn't that wonderful!
Oh no, my hair is a total mess!
I'll sing with all my feelings for you.
I'll do my very best too.
If I can be of use to you...
Yeah.
Okay!
Understood.
It's dangerous like that, Captain!
I need you to pull yourself together, Captain.
Are you really the captain?
I can't believe the captain got shot down.
Captain, are you alive?
Oh, the captain!
Just what I'd expect of the captain.
That was cool, Captain.
You did it, Hikaru!
I'll sing with all my heart!
I'm going to sing. Please listen.
Phew, I thought it was over.
I should be heading home. My aunt and uncle worry if I'm alone with a guy too long.
Next time, do it properly, okay?
Let's keep being friends from now on, okay?
Not bad! That was cool!
I'm glad you're safe.
Don't make me worry like that again.
Good work. When we're back, come see my concert. Promise!
You're an excellent pilot, after all. I knew you'd do great.
I'll give you a scarf next time. I'm sure it'll look good on you.
My boyfriend, a pilot? Just kidding!
You know, I've actually liked you all along. Hee hee, I'm not acting.
Ugh, never again.
Really, I'm just worn out.
